verdict: Meta is delivering leads at half the cost; pipeline conversion is the priority now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 36 leads at an average cost of $105.14 per lead — and every one of those leads came from Meta, which delivered them at roughly $51 each. Google Ads ran $1,949 in spend over the same window and produced only 2 conversions, making it the clear underperformer this period. Lead volume jumped 83% week-over-week, which is a strong signal, but 105 pipeline opportunities have yet to produce a single signed case, so the immediate focus is converting the leads already in hand. We're actively reviewing the Google Ads allocation and pushing on pipeline follow-up to turn inbound volume into retained clients.
